answer: Locks are entered in kernel, expire in prism, and sonnet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 177 aliases as a result needs 35 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4121 identities would post 690 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
